svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two (drawn lying down). Two UPN 100 channels 1,423 mm, square ends,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: webs back to back, flanges pointing sideways. Stitch weld the two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: web seams, 50 mm welds every 300 mm. The pair is 100 x 100 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes, 18 mm, through all four flanges, 28 mm each side of the web

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: seam, at 50, 110, 1,313 and 1,373 mm up from the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spacer tubes: 25 x 3 mm tube cut 83 mm long (flange to flange inside),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: eight per pair, slid in from the open side of each channel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shims: 2 mm steel, 100 x 120 mm, two 18 mm holes 56 mm apart;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one each side of each joint (eight per pair); add or thin to suit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bolts: M16 x 150 grade 10.9, hardened washer under head and nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bottom end stands on the foot; the pair sits between the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: beam webs with a shim each side; four bolts per joint through web,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shim, flange, tube, flange, shim, web.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: straight within 1 mm; mass about 29 kg (two people).
